name: Fashion Editorial Lookbook
tagline: Original editorial studies of silhouette, surface and movement

palette.description: Original composition retains this template tone: warm gray, black and white; photographic studies of neutral garments and natural fabrics.

typography.style: Original composition uses the existing licensed Fogtwo No5 display and Inter body font bytes. New type scale, grid and diagrams are authored for this template; no source slide DOM/CSS geometry or source artwork is reproduced.

best_for: Fashion and photography editorials that need complete visual-story sequences, circular and capsule crops, paired detail images, pattern layers, clothing credits and a native team-credit spread.
avoid_for: Dense business reporting, chart-heavy research, formal board materials or decks whose story depends on many paragraphs on every page.
